## Summary

We ran walk-forward OOS validation on 16-month data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) for the VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE candidate.

- Therefore, changing the DTE for this setup results in zero trades on these days.

## Conclusion

The candidate fails the walk-forward OOS gate (WF<0.70) and shows concentration in historical periods, making it non-robust. While it preserves the anchor edge_capture, it is not recommended for ratification due to OOS instability.
